findings.issue: じゃないか here is rhetorical confirmation ('right?/don't you think?'), exactly as the expl states; this English tag question instead asserts he is NOT a good person — the opposite polarity of the JP (en/pt/expl all say he seems good).
findings.current: He doesn't seem like a good person, does he?
findings.suggested: Seems like a good person, isn't it (= don't you think)?

findings.issue: なっ before た is the sokuonbin (促音便, geminate euphonic change) of the renyōkei of なる — not an 'い form'. Both the en and pt-BR notes carry the wrong label (apparently copied from the 聞い token, where 'い form' is correct).
findings.current: い form (renyōkei) of なる, linking to た
findings.suggested: っ form (sokuonbin of the renyōkei) of なる, linking to た / pt: forma っ (sokuonbin) de なる, ligando-se a た

findings.issue: Attaches the honorific お to the noun ('the honorable number 9'); in おかけ下さい the お belongs to the verb formula お+V-stem+ください, as both the expl and lit_pt ('honorífico-discar') correctly show. Misteaches the keigo structure.
findings.current: No, at the beginning, please dial the honorable number 9.
findings.suggested: No, at the beginning, to number 9, please (honorific-)dial.

findings.issue: 覚えなければ (with elided ならない) expresses obligation ('I'll have to memorize it someday'); 'I want to learn' shifts the modality to desire, contradicting pt ('preciso aprender'), lit_en ('if I don't memorize it won't do') and both expl fields.
findings.current: No, I don't. I want to learn sometime.
findings.suggested: No, I don't. I'll have to learn it sometime.

findings.issue: めったに+negative = 'quase nunca existem'; glossing めったに as 'raramente' while keeping 'não existem' creates a Portuguese double negative that reads 'raramente deixam de existir' (= usually exist) — inverted sense for the learner. lit_en avoided this ('are probably rare').
findings.current: Pessoas gentis daquele tipo, quanto a (elas), provavelmente raramente não existem.
findings.suggested: Pessoas gentis daquele tipo, quanto a (elas), provavelmente quase nunca existem.

findings.issue: This 言っ is the main verb of the concessive clause お礼を言っても; it is not the root of 言い切れない (that is the separate 言い / 言い切れ tokens). The role even contradicts the token's own note ('forma て de 言う, ligada a も para formar 〜ても').
findings.current: verbo (raiz de 言い切れない)
findings.suggested: verbo da oração concessiva (お礼を言っても)

findings.issue: Missing space: 'Algum dia[se eu]' should read 'Algum dia [se eu]'.
findings.current: Não, [eu] não sei. Algum dia[se eu] não memorizar [não dá]...
findings.suggested: Não, [eu] não sei. Algum dia [se eu] não memorizar [não dá]...

findings.issue: ませ (from ます) attached to the verb 降り is a politeness auxiliary, not a copula; '(polite copula/auxiliary)' mislabels it — pt '(cópula/auxiliar educado)' has the same problem. Elsewhere the corpus glosses ます as '(politeness marker)'.
イマイチ = 'not quite up to par / so-so' (the token gloss and pt 'meia-boca' are right); 'half-baked' applied to a person means foolish/immature — a different predicate about him.
findings.current: He's a good person, but half-baked, you know.
findings.suggested: He's a good person, but not quite there, you know.
